Bosham

Upon walking to the bay
On this fine & sunny day.
I stumbled across a pub,
Called “Anchor Bleu” - great grub.
After giving my waist a nudge,
I thought of buying caramel fudge.
And on reaching my destination,
It was eaten without hesitation.
